analysis.summary: This CV was optimized to highlight Tomas's strongest documented skills in financial analysis, forecasting, and process automation, which represent the closest transferable match to the operational and analytical dimensions of the Airbnb role. Given the significant gap between the candidate's finance background and the workplace operations/program management requirements of this position, the CV was crafted to present his genuine strengths honestly without fabricating missing competencies.
key_changes: Repositioned variance analysis and management reporting as core competencies in the headline and summary to align with the data analysis and measurement frameworks dimension of the JD
Highlighted the Excel VBA automation achievement as the strongest transferable signal toward the workflow automation requirement, using only verified language from the source CV
Removed all references to skills on the VERIFIED MISSING list, including program management, workplace operations, vendor management, and digital transformation, to maintain full accuracy
Consolidated experience to three most relevant roles with strict bullet limits, dropping the Finance Intern role to keep the CV focused and within the two-page constraint

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Airbnb

Dear Hiring Manager,

When I rebuilt a forecasting model around order backlog data, accuracy jumped from 88% to 96% across an 85 million USD business unit. That instinct to map how work actually flows, find where the process breaks down, and redesign it around better inputs is exactly what Airbnb's Workplace Operations team is looking for as it works to connect fragmented workflows across a global office footprint.

My background is in financial analysis rather than program management, so I want to be direct about where my value lies: I bring strong analytical and process-improvement skills that transfer well to this kind of operational modernization work. I have built reporting frameworks in Power BI on SAP data, automated manual processes using Excel VBA to cut month-end close from nine working days to six, and identified a 120,000 USD annual gap in unclaimed supplier rebates by looking carefully at where money was leaking. These are the same habits the role asks for: sizing opportunities in data, building the business case for change, and designing measurement frameworks that show whether improvements actually stuck.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my analytical background could contribute to Airbnb's workplace transformation agenda, and I am available at your convenience for a conversation.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt
